Protein evolution with RL

I developed a reinforcement learning framework to generate SARS-CoV-2 mutation trajectories and predict next-step mutations from genomic sequence data.

Professor Bonnie Berger’s labRSI → UROP · Jun 2024 – Present

My contribution

I developed the RL framework for two related tasks:

Trajectory generation
Generate sequences of mutations to model possible paths of protein evolution.
Next-step prediction
Predict a subsequent mutation rather than an entire trajectory.

Methods & evaluation

I built the preprocessing, training, and evaluation pipelines for large-scale genomic sequence data, and compared generated trajectories with observed mutation patterns to assess model behavior.

This page describes my contribution and methods. Quantitative results, model specifications, and evaluation datasets are not published here.
